verdict.rationale: Twenty lets you control where data lives by self-hosting on your own infrastructure with a single Docker Compose command, and it explicitly targets privacy-conscious organizations that need to own their data end to end. That is real residency control, but you have to run the infrastructure yourself. The evidence shows no region or residency choice on the managed cloud offering. Missing for 10: region selection for the hosted twenty.com cloud, documented residency/compliance guarantees, independent corroboration.
